🚇 A typical weekday on the Madrid Metro.

One of Europe's largest metro networks, opened in 1919, shown from the 6 a.m. opening to the evening. Each dot is a train following the real track, in its line colour, generated from the published service frequencies. Line 3 is missing from the open data used here.
